incidents.rootCause: System PowerShell execution policy blocks the npm.ps1 wrapper
incidents.fix: Use npm.cmd on this Windows machine

incidents.rootCause: The allowlisted view was absent or not visible in the PostgREST schema cache at that time
incidents.fix: Owner created/exposed the read-only view and refreshed availability

incidents.symptom: SQL query failed because health_status did not exist
incidents.rootCause: The query assumed a column not proven by the live schema
incidents.fix: Inspect actual columns before selecting optional health fields
